name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with feet supported. Lower the bar under control, then press it upward. Use safeties or a spotter when appropriate.

name: Barbell back squat
instructions: Support the bar securely on your upper back. Bend at the hips and knees, then return to standing with a controlled movement.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: With a slight knee bend, move the hips backward while lowering the bar close to the legs. Return to standing under control.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Begin with dumbbells near shoulder height. Press overhead under control, then lower. Record the weight of one dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell curl
instructions: Keep the upper arms steady while bending the elbows to lift the dumbbells. Lower under control. Record the weight of one dumbbell.

name: Cable triceps pushdown
instructions: Keep the upper arms near your sides. Extend the elbows to press the attachment down, then return under control. Record the displayed load.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: With a secure seated position, pull the attachment toward the upper chest, then return under control. Record the displayed load.

name: Push-up
instructions: Maintain a stable body position. Bend the elbows to lower your torso, then press back up.

name: Pull-up
instructions: From a controlled hang, pull upward toward the bar, then lower under control.

name: Weighted pull-up
instructions: Secure the added load before starting. Perform controlled pull-ups. Record added weight separately from bodyweight.

name: Assisted pull-up
instructions: Set the machine assistance and follow its setup instructions. Perform controlled pull-ups. Record assistance as a positive amount, not a negative weight.

name: Plank
instructions: Support yourself on forearms and toes, keeping a stable trunk. Record the time held in seconds.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and dumbbells beside the chest. Press both weights upward without bouncing them together. Lower with the forearms under the weights.
notes: Set the dumbbells down under control at the end of the set. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Incline barbell bench press
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to a low incline inside a rack. Unrack the bar with wrists above the elbows, lower toward the upper chest, then press back to the start.
notes: Use rack safeties or a spotter. Keep the chosen incline consistent between sessions. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Incline dumbbell bench press
instructions: Sit against a low-incline bench with the dumbbells near the upper chest. Press upward while keeping the torso against the pad. Lower both weights through a comfortable range.
notes: Use the same bench angle for comparable records. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Decline barbell bench press
instructions: Secure the legs on a decline bench beneath a racked bar. Unrack with assistance if needed, lower the bar toward the lower chest, then press upward under control.
notes: Use a bench designed for decline pressing and arrange safeties or a spotter. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Decline dumbbell bench press
instructions: Secure yourself on a decline bench and position both dumbbells beside the chest. Press them above the torso, then lower without letting the shoulders roll forward.
notes: Arrange a controlled way to get the weights into and out of position. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Close-grip barbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold the bar with a comfortably narrow grip. Lower with the wrists aligned over the forearms and elbows near the torso. Press to straight arms without bouncing.
notes: A close grip does not require the hands to touch. Use safeties or a spotter. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Paused barbell bench press
instructions: Lower a racked barbell to the chest while keeping the upper back set. Hold the bar motionless briefly without relaxing into the chest, then press to the start.
notes: Use a consistent pause duration for comparison; do not bounce the bar. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor under a safely racked bar with knees bent. Lower until the upper arms gently contact the floor. Maintain tension and press upward without rebounding.
notes: Set rack safeties for the floor position; the floor limits the bottom range. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and dumbbells above the chest. Lower until the upper arms lightly touch the floor, then press both weights upward.
notes: Keep the elbows controlled rather than striking or bouncing off the floor. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Neutral-grip dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with palms facing each other. Lower the dumbbells beside the chest while keeping that grip. Press both weights upward with the feet supported.
notes: Keep the palms-in grip throughout; this is distinct from the standard pronated press. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell beside the chest. Brace the torso so the hips do not roll, press the weight up, then lower. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Use a load that allows a stable torso; do not twist to finish the press. Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Smith machine bench press
instructions: Position a flat bench so the Smith bar reaches the chest without forcing the shoulders. Set the stops, unlock the bar, then lower and press along the rails.
notes: Check bench placement with an unloaded carriage before loading plates. Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Incline Smith machine bench press
instructions: Place a low-incline bench under the Smith bar and set the stops. Unlock the carriage, lower toward the upper chest, then press while keeping the back supported.
notes: Keep the bench angle and position consistent; rail angles differ between machines. Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated chest press machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start around mid-chest. Keep the back on the pad, press the handles forward, then return without letting the stack slam.
notes: Follow the machine setup markings and use the same handle option for comparisons. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Plate-loaded chest press machine
instructions: Set the seat on a plate-loaded horizontal chest press and load the working levers evenly. Press both handles away from the chest, then lower the levers under control.
notes: This entry records a bilateral set on a plate-loaded machine, not a selectorized stack. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Plate-loaded incline chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat on an incline press machine so the handles align with the upper chest. Press along the machine path, then return with the torso against the pad.
notes: Use equal loading on independent arms for bilateral sets. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Standing cable chest press
instructions: Set two cable handles around chest height and take a stable split stance. Brace, press both handles forward, then return without letting the cables pull the torso backward.
notes: Two matching handles and two independent pulleys are required. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm standing cable chest press
instructions: Face away from a chest-height pulley in a split stance. Press one handle forward without turning the torso, then bring it back beside the chest. Change sides.
notes: Keep the ribs and pelvis facing forward rather than rotating through the press. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell chest fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above the chest. With a small fixed elbow bend, open the arms to a comfortable depth, then bring the weights back over the chest.
notes: Keep the elbow angle nearly constant; do not turn the return into a press. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Incline dumbbell chest fly
instructions: Lie against a low-incline bench with dumbbells above the upper chest. Open the arms with softly bent elbows, then close the same arc without lifting the torso.
notes: Do not chase extra depth by letting the shoulders roll forward. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Standing cable chest fly
instructions: Set two pulleys around chest height and stand between them. With a slight fixed elbow bend, sweep the handles together in front of the chest, then reopen under control.
notes: Use equal stack settings. Keep the crossing point consistent rather than alternating large overlaps. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Low-to-high cable chest fly
instructions: Start with two handles on low pulleys and a stable stance. Sweep the arms forward and upward toward the upper chest with elbows softly bent. Return along the same path.
notes: The upward path is a variation, not isolation of a separate upper-chest muscle. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: High-to-low cable chest fly
instructions: Take handles from high pulleys and step into a stable stance. Bring the arms down and inward in front of the lower chest, then reopen slowly.
notes: Maintain the elbow bend and avoid using a torso dip to move the load. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Pec deck chest fly
instructions: Set the seat so the upper arms align with the machine pivots. Bring the pads or handles together in front of the chest, then return without forcing a deep stretch.
notes: Use the machine in its chest-fly configuration, not the reverse-fly position. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Standing barbell overhead press
instructions: Start with the bar at the upper chest and feet planted. Brace the trunk and press overhead without dipping the knees. Lower to the starting position under control.
notes: Keep this entry strict; use the separate push-press entry when using leg drive. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated barbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit against an upright bench with the bar racked in front of you. Unrack, press overhead without lifting off the pad, then lower the bar in front of the face.
notes: Set safeties and use a comfortable front-of-body bar path; this is not a behind-neck press. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit with the back supported and dumbbells near shoulder height. Press both weights overhead, then lower with the forearms beneath the dumbbells.
notes: Keep the bench position consistent and avoid sliding into a steep incline chest press. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated Arnold press
instructions: Sit upright with dumbbells in front of the shoulders and palms facing you. Rotate the arms outward as you press overhead. Reverse the motion smoothly on the way down.
notes: Use a comfortable rotation and avoid forcing the shoulders behind the torso. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated neutral-grip dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit against an upright backrest with palms facing each other. Press both dumbbells overhead while retaining the neutral grip, then lower beside the shoulders.
notes: Keep the palms-in position throughout the set. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm standing dumbbell overhead press
instructions: Hold one dumbbell near the shoulder while standing tall. Press overhead without leaning sideways or dipping the knees, then lower and repeat on the other arm.
notes: Brace against the sideways pull of the single weight; no leg drive. Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Seated Smith machine shoulder press
instructions: Place an upright bench under the Smith bar with the bar path in front of the face. Set the stops, unlock the carriage, then press overhead and lower under control.
notes: Check the unloaded path first; do not force a behind-neck position to fit the rails. Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Shoulder press machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles begin near shoulder height. Keep the torso supported, press the handles upward, then return without dropping the stack.
notes: Use the same handle option and seat setting for comparable logs. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Half-kneeling single-arm landmine press
instructions: Secure one bar end in a landmine attachment and kneel with the opposite foot forward. Hold the sleeve near the working shoulder, press it diagonally forward and up, then return.
notes: Keep the trunk facing forward. The anchored bar follows an arc rather than a vertical path. Record plates added at the free end only; exclude the bar and attachment. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell push press
instructions: Hold the bar in a front-rack position. Make a short upright knee dip, drive through the legs and finish the press overhead. Lower and reset before the next repetition.
notes: This is a push press, not a jerk: do not re-bend the knees to catch the bar. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell push press
instructions: Hold two dumbbells at the shoulders. Dip slightly through the knees with the torso upright, then drive the legs and press both weights overhead. Lower and reset the rack position.
notes: Count one leg drive and overhead finish as one rep; do not turn the set into repeated bouncing. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell Z press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs forward and the torso tall. Start the dumbbells at shoulder height, press overhead, then lower without rolling backward or using leg drive.
notes: Use a position that lets the torso stay upright; floor sitting makes this distinct from a back-supported press. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell bent-over row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a braced torso and hold the bar below the shoulders. Pull toward the lower ribs, then extend the elbows without changing the torso angle.
notes: Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Underhand barbell row
instructions: Hinge with an underhand grip and the bar hanging beneath the shoulders. Draw the elbows back toward the hips, lower smoothly and keep the wrists straight.
notes: Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Pendlay row
instructions: Start each rep with the bar resting on the floor and the torso near horizontal. Brace, row toward the lower chest without standing up, then return the bar to the floor and reset.
notes: Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench, keeping the back steady. Pull the other dumbbell toward the hip, then lower to a controlled arm extension. Complete both sides.
notes: Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging and palms facing each other. Row toward the hips with elbows close, then lower without lifting the chest off the pad.
notes: Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell seal row
instructions: Lie face down on a raised seal-row bench with the bar below and enough clearance for full arm extension. Row toward the underside of the bench, then lower while keeping the chest supported.
notes: Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Incline-bench dumbbell high row
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench and hold dumbbells with palms facing back. Row with elbows out toward shoulder height, then lower under control without shrugging.
notes: Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with knees slightly bent and hold the neutral handle. Pull toward the lower ribs with a steady torso, then extend the arms without rounding the lower back.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Wide-grip seated cable row
instructions: Sit at a cable row station holding a wide overhand bar grip. Pull toward the upper abdomen with elbows out, then return without leaning backward to move the stack.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm seated cable row
instructions: Sit square to a cable row station and hold one handle. Row toward the working hip while keeping both shoulders facing forward, then reach under control. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Single-arm standing cable row
instructions: Stand in a split stance facing a cable set around lower-chest height. Row one handle toward the ribs without rotating the torso, then return. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Half-kneeling single-arm cable row
instructions: Half-kneel facing a cable set near chest height and hold one handle. Pull toward the working ribs with hips and shoulders square, then extend the arm. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Chest-supported row machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so the handles are reachable with arms extended. Keep the chest supported, pull the handles back, then return without letting the stack slam.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Plate-loaded chest-supported row
instructions: Load the working levers evenly and adjust the chest support. Row both handles toward the ribs while staying against the pad, then lower the levers smoothly.
notes: Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm row machine
instructions: Adjust a supported selectorized row machine and hold one independent handle. Keep the torso against the pad, row the working arm, then return. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Chest-supported T-bar row
instructions: Set the chest pad and stand on the T-bar row platform. With the chest supported, pull the handles toward the ribs, then lower to a controlled arm extension.
notes: Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Meadows row
instructions: Stand side-on to the free end of an anchored bar and hinge with a staggered stance. Grip the sleeve overhand, row toward the hip and lower without twisting the trunk. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record plates added at the free end only; exclude the bar and attachment. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Landmine T-bar row
instructions: Straddle an anchored bar and attach a suitable neutral row handle near its free end. Hinge with a braced back, pull toward the lower ribs, then lower without jerking the torso upward.
notes: Record plates added at the free end only; exclude the bar and attachment. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Smith machine bent-over row
instructions: Set the Smith bar low, take an overhand grip and hinge with knees softly bent. Pull along the rails toward the abdomen, then lower while holding the torso angle.
notes: Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Set a secure fixed bar above floor level and hang beneath it with heels on the floor. Keep the body straight, pull the chest toward the bar, then lower with control.
notes: Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Feet-elevated inverted row
instructions: Hang beneath a secure fixed bar with heels on a stable raised platform. Brace the body in a straight line, pull the chest toward the bar, then lower without dropping the hips.
notes: Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell pullover
instructions: Lie lengthwise on a bench holding one dumbbell above the chest. With elbows slightly bent, lower behind the head only as far as the ribs stay down, then bring the weight back above the chest.
notes: Keep the elbow angle nearly constant; this is not a triceps extension. Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Straight-arm cable pulldown
instructions: Face a high pulley with a bar attachment. Keep a small fixed elbow bend and pull the bar toward the thighs, then return overhead without leaning farther forward.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Rope straight-arm cable pulldown
instructions: Face a high pulley holding the rope ends. Keep elbows softly bent, sweep the hands down beside the thighs, then return without arching the back.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
instructions: Secure the thighs under the pad and hold a neutral pulldown handle. Pull toward the upper chest with elbows moving down, then let the arms extend without lifting out of the seat.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Underhand lat pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured and take a shoulder-width underhand grip. Pull toward the upper chest, then return smoothly without swinging backward or bending the wrists.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Wide-grip lat pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured and grip the bar moderately wider than the shoulders. Pull in front of the head toward the upper chest, then return overhead. Avoid an extreme grip width.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Half-kneeling single-arm cable lat pulldown
instructions: Half-kneel beneath a high cable holding one handle. Pull the elbow down toward the working ribs without tilting sideways, then reach overhead under control. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Plate-loaded lat pulldown machine
instructions: Load the machine levers evenly and adjust the seat and thigh support. Pull the handles downward toward the shoulders, then return without letting the levers drop.
notes: Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with an underhand grip. Pull until the chin clears the bar without kicking, then lower to a comfortable arm extension.
notes: Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Neutral-grip pull-up
instructions: Hang from secure parallel pull-up handles with palms facing each other. Pull upward without swinging, then lower under control to a comfortable arm extension.
notes: Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Weighted chin-up
instructions: Secure added weight to a dip belt and hang from a bar with an underhand grip. Pull the chin above the bar without swinging, then lower smoothly. Keep the plates clear of nearby objects.
notes: Record added weight separately from optional bodyweight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Assisted chin-up machine
instructions: Select assistance and mount the assisted pull-up machine according to its design. Take an underhand grip, pull upward without bouncing the support pad, then lower under control.
notes: Record the displayed assistance as a positive amount, separately from optional bodyweight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Scapular pull-up
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with straight elbows. Draw the shoulders gently down to raise the torso a small distance, then return to the starting hang. Keep the elbows straight throughout.
notes: Use a comfortable shoulder range rather than forcing a passive hang. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm seated lat pulldown
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station with thighs secured and one cable handle overhead. Pull the working elbow toward the ribs while keeping the torso square, then extend overhead. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Band lat pulldown
instructions: Secure a suitable band to an overhead anchor and kneel beneath it. Hold both ends, pull the elbows down toward the ribs, then return slowly. Check the band and anchor before loading them.
notes: Log repetitions without a kilogram estimate. Note band type and tension in workout notes. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Cable face pull
instructions: Set the rope around face height. Pull the ends toward the sides of the face with elbows out and rotate the hands back comfortably. Return without leaning backward.
notes: Use a light enough load to keep the neck relaxed and the movement controlled. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Reverse pec deck fly
instructions: Face the machine pad and adjust the handles near shoulder height. Open the arms outward with a small fixed elbow bend, then return without lifting the chest from the pad.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Bent-over dumbbell reverse fly
instructions: Hinge at the hips with dumbbells beneath the chest. Raise the arms out to the sides with softly bent elbows, then lower without swinging the torso.
notes: Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell reverse fly
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging beneath the shoulders. Raise the arms outward with a fixed slight elbow bend, then lower while keeping the chest supported.
notes: Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Standing cable reverse fly
instructions: Set two pulleys near shoulder height and hold the opposite handles with cables crossed. Open both arms outward without leaning back, then return slowly to the crossed starting position.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells beside the thighs and elbows softly bent. Raise the arms out slightly forward of the sides to around shoulder height, then lower without shrugging or swinging.
notes: Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-arm cable lateral raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the farther hand. Raise the arm outward to around shoulder height, then lower smoothly. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Alternating dumbbell front raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of the thighs. Raise one arm forward to around shoulder height, lower it, then alternate arms without rocking the torso. Count repetitions separately for each side.
notes: Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell front squat
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of the shoulders inside a rack. Brace with elbows lifted, sit down between the hips, then stand while keeping the bar over the midfoot.
notes: Choose a secure front-rack grip and set the safeties before loading. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Paused barbell back squat
instructions: Unrack the bar across the upper back and brace. Squat to a controlled depth, pause without relaxing the trunk, then stand through both feet.
notes: Keep pause length consistent between sessions; do not bounce out of the bottom. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell box squat
instructions: Set a stable squat box behind you inside the rack. With the bar on the upper back, sit back and down to controlled contact, then stand without rocking or collapsing onto the box.
notes: Choose a repeatable box height. Keep the trunk braced on contact. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell pin squat
instructions: Set the bar on rack pins at the intended squat depth. Get underneath it, brace and stand the bar up, then lower gently onto both pins and reset before the next rep.
notes: Use a conservative load and a rack that allows a secure starting position. This entry starts from the pins each rep. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Safety-bar squat
instructions: Set the safety bar pads over the shoulders and hold the front handles. Unrack, brace and squat between the hips, then stand without pulling the handles down to force the chest up.
notes: Include the actual specialty-bar mass in the recorded total; these bars vary in weight. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Zercher squat
instructions: Set the bar in a rack near waist height and cradle it in the elbow crooks. Brace, step clear and squat while keeping the load close, then stand and re-rack under control.
notes: Use a comfortable elbow position and a modest starting load. Do not lift the bar from the floor for this entry. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell hack squat
instructions: Stand with a bar behind the legs and take an overhand grip. Bend the knees and hips, brace, then stand while guiding the bar close behind the legs. Lower to the floor and reset.
notes: This is the free-bar movement, not a hack squat machine. Use a range that does not force the shoulders or bar around the knees. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell upright close to the chest. Brace, squat between the hips with heels grounded, then stand without letting the weight drift away from the torso.
notes: Keep the dumbbell secure with both hands; record its single weight. Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Double-dumbbell front squat
instructions: Hold two equal dumbbells at the shoulders with elbows forward. Brace, squat down between the hips, then stand while keeping both weights supported near the shoulders.
notes: Use a consistent shoulder-rack position rather than holding the weights at the sides. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell suitcase squat
instructions: Stand with equal dumbbells beside the thighs. Bend the knees and hips to squat while keeping the weights beside the body, then stand without shrugging or swinging them.
notes: This is a knee-bending squat, not a Romanian deadlift. Keep the handles clear of the legs. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Heels-elevated dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Place both heels on a stable wedge and hold a dumbbell at the chest. Squat with knees following the toes and the torso controlled, then stand while maintaining foot contact.
notes: Use a secure wedge, not loose objects. Keep the elevation consistent for comparison. Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell sumo squat
instructions: Take a comfortable wide stance with toes turned out and hold one dumbbell between the legs. Bend the hips and knees, lower between the thighs, then stand without rounding the back.
notes: Choose stance width from your comfortable range rather than forcing an extreme turnout. Record the weight of the single dumbbell used. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Stand with feet in a comfortable squat stance. Brace lightly, sit down between the hips with heels supported, then return to standing under control.
notes: Use a depth you can control; no external load is required. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Bodyweight box squat
instructions: Stand in front of a stable box or seat. Lower to a controlled seated contact, then stand through both feet without pushing off with the hands.
notes: Use a box height that permits control and keep that height consistent. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Smith machine squat
instructions: Set Smith stops and position the bar across the upper back. Choose a foot position that follows the rail path comfortably, unlock, squat and stand before re-locking the bar.
notes: Check the path unloaded first; rail angles and carriage resistance differ between machines. Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Smith machine front squat
instructions: Position the Smith bar on the fronts of the shoulders with a secure front rack. Set stops, test the rail path, then unlock, squat and press through the feet to stand.
notes: Do not force the wrists or shoulders to fit an unsuitable rail path. Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: 45-degree leg press
instructions: Sit against the back pad and place both feet on the sled plate. Release the safeties, lower until you can keep the pelvis supported, then press the sled away without snapping the knees straight.
notes: Record added plates only, excluding the sled. Re-engage the machine safeties before leaving. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Horizontal leg press machine
instructions: Adjust the seat on a horizontal selectorized leg press. Keep the back and pelvis against the pad, press through both feet, then bend the knees to return the stack slowly.
notes: Use the displayed stack setting and keep seat and foot positions consistent. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-leg 45-degree leg press
instructions: Set a conservative sled load and place one foot securely on the plate. Keep the pelvis square against the pad, lower under control and press away, then repeat with the other leg.
notes: Use the same plate load for each leg and record all added plates, not half the sled load. Use both legs to secure or release safeties as needed. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Hack squat machine
instructions: Set the shoulder pads and feet on a hack squat machine. Release the stops, bend the knees while keeping the back supported, then stand along the sled path and re-engage the stops.
notes: Choose a controlled depth without the pelvis peeling off the pad; exclude sled mass from the recorded plates. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Pendulum squat machine
instructions: Fit the shoulder and back pads on a pendulum squat machine and place the feet securely. Release its catch, squat along the arc, then stand while staying against the pads.
notes: Follow the machine setup and catch instructions. Its lever arc differs from a linear hack squat sled. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Belt squat machine
instructions: Fasten the machine belt around the hips and attach it as directed. Stand to release the support, squat while keeping the belt load centred, then stand and secure the support before unclipping.
notes: This entry is for a plate-loaded machine with its own belt; count the added plates, not your bodyweight. Record the total plates added to all working levers, excluding the unloaded machine. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Landmine squat
instructions: Hold the free end of an anchored bar at the chest with both hands. Squat while allowing the bar to follow its arc, then stand without leaning back to finish.
notes: Use a secure landmine attachment and leave room for the plate arc. Record plates added at the free end only; exclude the bar and attachment. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell cyclist squat
instructions: Set both heels on a stable wedge inside the rack and place the bar on the upper back. Squat with a comfortably narrow stance and controlled knee travel, then stand without shifting off the wedge.
notes: Do not force feet together. Keep wedge height and stance consistent; use safeties. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Conventional barbell deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over the midfoot and grip just outside the legs. Brace, take tension out of the bar and push through the floor to stand. Lower close to the legs and reset on the floor.
notes: Finish tall without leaning back. This entry starts from the floor, unlike the existing Romanian deadlift. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Sumo barbell deadlift
instructions: Stand wide with toes comfortably turned out and grip the bar inside the legs. Brace and drive the feet into the floor to stand, then lower the bar close to the shins and reset.
notes: Keep the knees following the toes; avoid forcing a wider stance than you can control. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: High-handle trap-bar deadlift
instructions: Stand centred inside a trap bar with raised handles. Bend knees and hips, brace and grip both high handles, then stand evenly. Lower both sides to the floor together and reset.
notes: Record the actual trap-bar mass plus plates. High handles shorten the range compared with low handles. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Low-handle trap-bar deadlift
instructions: Stand centred inside a trap bar and use the low handles. Brace before lifting, extend hips and knees to stand, then lower both sides evenly to the floor and reset.
notes: Use a load appropriate to the deeper starting position. Record the actual bar mass plus plates. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell rack pull
instructions: Set the bar on rack pins at a repeatable height. Grip and brace with the bar near the legs, extend the hips to stand, then return gently to the pins and reset.
notes: Record pin height in notes. Avoid pulling backward into an exaggerated lumbar extension. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Deficit barbell deadlift
instructions: Stand on a low stable platform with the bar on the floor. Grip outside the legs, brace and stand while keeping the bar close, then lower and reset without losing the longer starting position.
notes: Use only a modest deficit that lets you maintain control; do not stack unstable plates beneath the feet. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Paused barbell deadlift
instructions: Start a conventional deadlift and pause briefly with the bar below the knees. Keep the trunk braced and bar close, finish standing, then lower to the floor and reset.
notes: Keep the pause position and duration consistent; do not rest the bar on the legs during the pause. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell deadlift
instructions: Place equal dumbbells beside the feet. Bend knees and hips to grip them, brace and stand through the floor, then lower both weights to the starting position and reset.
notes: Small dumbbells require a deep start. Use suitable fixed-height supports if needed and note the starting height; do not round the back to reach the floor. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Start standing with equal dumbbells in front of the thighs. Soften the knees and send the hips back, keeping the weights close. Stop at a controlled hamstring stretch and stand by bringing the hips forward.
notes: Maintain a small knee bend; touching the floor is not required. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells and balance on one leg with a soft knee. Hinge at that hip as the other leg extends behind, then return to standing without opening the pelvis sideways. Repeat on the other side.
notes: This entry uses two dumbbells. Record one dumbbell weight and reps per working leg. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Kickstand dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells with one foot forward and the other toes lightly behind. Keep most weight on the front leg, hinge the hips back, then stand through that leg. Switch the stance for the other side.
notes: The rear toes provide balance rather than a second equally loaded working leg. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Single-leg barbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Start standing with a barbell and shift onto one leg. Hinge while letting the free leg travel behind, keep the bar close, then return without twisting the pelvis. Repeat on the other leg.
notes: Use a light load until balance is controlled. Start and finish with the bar securely supported when changing position. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell good morning
instructions: Unrack a bar onto the upper back and soften the knees. Brace and push the hips back as the torso inclines, then extend the hips to return upright while keeping the bar secure.
notes: Use rack safeties and a conservative range; do not turn the return into a back hyperextension. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Seated barbell good morning
instructions: Sit on a stable bench inside the rack with a light bar on the upper back. Brace and hinge forward from the hips with feet planted, then bring the torso upright without bouncing.
notes: Use a short controlled range and set safeties. Bent knees reduce hamstring stretch compared with the standing version. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Safety-bar good morning
instructions: Set the safety bar pads on the shoulders and hold its handles. Soften the knees, hinge the hips backward while braced, then stand without yanking the handles down.
notes: Use rack safeties and include the actual safety-bar mass in the total load. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
instructions: Set the Smith bar near thigh height and test the rail path. Unlock, soften the knees and hinge the hips back while keeping the bar near the legs, then stand and re-lock under control.
notes: Choose foot position to suit the rails and use stops; a floor touch is not the goal. Record added plates only; exclude the Smith carriage rather than estimating its effective weight. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Cable pull-through
instructions: Face away from a low pulley and hold the rope between the legs. Step clear, hinge backward through the hips, then stand by driving the hips forward while keeping the arms long.
notes: Move through the hips rather than squatting or pulling the rope with the arms. Avoid leaning back at the finish. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Cable Romanian deadlift
instructions: Face a low pulley holding a bar attachment in front of the thighs. Keep the knees softly bent and arms long as the hips hinge back, then extend the hips to stand.
notes: Maintain enough distance for cable tension without being pulled off balance; do not row the handle. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Single-leg cable Romanian deadlift
instructions: Face a low pulley with the handle in the hand opposite the working leg. Hinge on that leg as the free leg moves behind, then stand without rotating the hips. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Keep the cable line clear of the legs and use a load that does not pull you forward. Record the displayed setting of the working stack. For two independent stacks, use equal settings and record ONE stack, not their sum. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Landmine Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold the free end of an anchored bar in front of the thighs. Soften the knees, hinge back while following the bar arc, then extend the hips to stand with the arms long.
notes: Keep the attachment secured; do not add a squat or arm pull to move a heavy load. Record plates added at the free end only; exclude the bar and attachment. One complete bilateral movement counts as one rep.

name: Barbell forward lunge
instructions: Unrack a bar onto the upper back. Step forward, lower by bending both knees, then push through the front foot to return to the starting stance. Complete equal reps on both sides.
notes: Allow room to step and recover balance. Count repetitions for each leading leg, not combined steps. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell reverse lunge
instructions: Hold a racked bar on the upper back and brace. Step one foot backward, lower both knees under control, then drive through the front foot to return. Repeat for the other side.
notes: Keep the front foot grounded and leave enough room behind the rack. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell walking lunge
instructions: Unrack the bar with space to walk. Step into a lunge, lower under control, then rise and bring the rear leg through into the next step. Maintain balance before each descent.
notes: Count working steps per leg rather than distance. Use an unobstructed path and a safe way to re-rack. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell forward lunge
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells at the sides. Step forward and lower with both knees bending, then press through the front foot to return to standing. Repeat on the other leg without swinging the weights.
notes: Keep a comfortable step length and enough width between the feet for balance. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells beside the thighs. Step one foot backward, lower both knees, then stand through the front foot and return the rear foot to the start. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Control the backward step; do not push forcefully off the rear toes to finish. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell walking lunge
instructions: Carry equal dumbbells at the sides along a clear path. Step into a lunge, lower with control, then rise and step through into the next lunge without letting the weights swing.
notes: Log repetitions per leg. Distance is not measured by the current workout logger. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells and step to one side. Sit into the stepping hip as that knee bends and the other leg stays relatively straight, then push back to the start. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Keep the working foot grounded and use a side-step distance you can control. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
instructions: Stand tall, step one foot backward and lower by bending both knees. Push through the front foot to return to standing, keeping the torso controlled. Repeat on the other leg.
notes: Choose a step width that allows balance; the rear knee does not need to strike the floor. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Bodyweight walking lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge and lower with control. Rise through the front leg and bring the rear leg forward for the next lunge. Continue along a clear path without rushing the steps.
notes: Count repetitions per leg, not total distance or combined alternating steps. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Bodyweight lateral lunge
instructions: Step sideways from standing and bend the stepping knee as the hips move back. Keep the other leg long and both feet supported, then push back to the start and repeat on the other side.
notes: Lower only as far as the foot and knee remain controlled; avoid rolling onto the inner edge of the foot. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Bodyweight split squat
instructions: Set a split stance with the rear heel raised and keep both feet in place. Bend both knees to lower the torso, then stand through the front foot. Change stance after the planned repetitions.
notes: This is a stationary split squat, not a stepping lunge. Log repetitions; recording bodyweight is optional. Do not enter bodyweight as external load. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell split squat
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells at the sides and take a split stance. Lower by bending both knees without moving the feet, then stand through the front leg. Repeat with the other leg forward.
notes: Keep enough side-to-side space between the feet to stay balanced. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell split squat
instructions: Unrack the bar onto the upper back and set a stable split stance. Bend both knees to lower, then rise through the front foot while keeping the feet fixed. Reposition safely to change sides.
notes: Use rack safeties where practical and a load that allows controlled stance changes. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Dumbbell rear-foot-elevated split squat
instructions: Hold equal dumbbells with the rear foot resting on a stable bench. Lower through the front hip and knee, then stand through the front foot without driving hard into the bench. Repeat on the other side.
notes: Use a bench height and foot position that let the pelvis stay controlled; the rear foot is support, not the main driver. Record the weight of one dumbbell; use equal dumbbells for two-arm sets. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.

name: Barbell rear-foot-elevated split squat
instructions: Set a bench and rack for a safe starting position with the bar on the upper back. Rest the rear foot on the bench, lower through the front leg and stand, then change sides under control.
notes: Use conservative loading and a secure setup; balance and safe re-racking take priority over depth. Record the total barbell load, including the bar and plates. Reps are per side. Use the same reps on each side; log sides separately if they differ.
